name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys' journey into motorsport began not at the track, but in front of a computer screen. Growing up in rural Wales, he spent countless hours tinkering with simulations, mastering the intricacies of vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. He honed his skills through online racing leagues and modding communities, eventually catching the eye of a prominent sim racing team. This led to a role developing their in-house simulation platform. 

He brings a methodical and detail-oriented approach to his work at Hitech GP, believing that even the smallest adjustment in the simulator can translate to significant gains on the track. Rhys is known for his ability to quickly identify and resolve technical issues, and his innovative ideas have helped the team push the boundaries of what's possible with simulation technology. His loyalty to the team is unwavering.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of keyboard and mouse.
